create_directory_if_missing: create a directory at the given path if it does not already exist
check_and_make_dir: check if a directory exists and create it if not found
cull_strings_by_includes: cull a list of strings to those containing any of the included substrings
filter_strings_by_substrings: filter a list of strings keeping only those with included substrings and without excluded ones
review_cull_string_list: review the cull_string_list_by_substrings function to filter strings by included and excluded substrings
